title: Validated ABOG certification status for the URPS board-certified cohort — urps_abog_cert_status
text: raw, coalesced certStatus refresh merge distinguish physician actually re-scraped 2026 one whose old "Active"-looking status simply carried forward re-scrape never reached . cert_category_current corrects : "Active"-looking status reported "Active" refresh_is_current TRUE; otherwise downgraded "Unknown (stale active status)". Time-limited certifications since lapsed downgraded "Expired". Neither certStatus (ABOG's raw text) cert_category_current (corrected classification) modeled estimated – come straight source audit. Scope: URPS/FPMRS board-certified cohort (subspecialty_name == "Female Pelvic Medicine & Reconstructive Surgery" ABOG roster), matching every urps_* accessor package. GO/MIGS full ABOG-wide roster scope ; see cliff's data/abog_provider_dataframe_*.csv unfiltered roster. retirement model. cert_category_current ABOG's certification-status vocabulary (Active / Retired / Deceased / Certification lapsed / Unknown ...), observed directly source, modeled workforce-exit estimate. Modeled retirement cliff's responsibility (urps_retirement_hazard()).
